expo.name: QRAlalay
expo.description: QRAlalay is a Capstone System Prototype for community assistance and resident reunification, developed by the QRAlalay Student Research Team at the Technological University of the Philippines. Study location: Barangay 206, Tondo, Manila, Philippines. Teknolohiya na may malasakit. Public inquiries: qralalayhelp@gmail.com | https://www.qralalay.app

plugins.cameraPermission: QRAlalay uses the camera to scan resident QR cards.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: QRAlalay uses your location to record where a QR code was scanned during an emergency.

plugins.photosPermission: QRAlalay uses your photos so you can add a profile picture for a resident or account.
plugins.cameraPermission: QRAlalay uses the camera so you can take a profile picture for a resident or account.
